name: memory-brain
description: Visible, backed-up memory for Claude Code: a health badge on every new chat, a diary log, a secret scanner and automatic git backup of your memory folder.

brain_dir.title: Memory folder
brain_dir.description: The folder that holds your memory notes (MEMORY.md lives here). Usually the same folder as autoMemoryDirectory.

backup_remote.title: Backup git address
backup_remote.description: Where backups are pushed: a git remote name (e.g. origin) or any git URL. Leave empty for local-only commits.

stale_days.title: Days before a project note counts as stale
stale_days.description: Project notes not edited for this many days are counted as stale in the badge.

gh_account.title: GitHub CLI account to push as (optional)
gh_account.description: If set, backups push with this gh login's token instead of git's saved account. Leave empty for plain git.

commit_name.title: Backup commit author name (optional)
commit_name.description: Name on backup commits. Leave empty to use your git config.

commit_email.title: Backup commit author email (optional)
commit_email.description: Email on backup commits, e.g. a noreply address. Leave empty to use your git config.
